Variants.Content: Located between the wet coast and rainforests of the Stormlands, Rainhouse City is the traditional castle of House Wilder. The name here comes from the rain that never stops: roof tiles, roads, trees and people's tempers are all penetrated by water vapor. Navigation along Shipbreaker Bay is dangerous, and storms and reefs can make even the most skilled captains miscalculate. On land, there are dense forests, mud, and narrow roads, making it difficult for the army to deploy as easily as on the river bend plains. Rainhouse Castle therefore had to look after the coast, but also relied on woodland acquaintances and local supplies. It is not an abstract military symbol, but a residence shaped by the natural environment of the storm.

Entry Rain House Local families also depend on rainforest timber, game, barren farmland, fisheries, and roofs to protect themselves from storms; any time a road, well, or dock fails, the price falls first on them.

Entry Rain House If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Rain House A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Rain House They care about rainforest timber, prey, barren farmland, fish catches, and roofs to shelter from storms. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain, and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
